title: Decision-tree pathway model
primary_chapter_title: Decision Modelling, Simulation, and the Value of Information
purpose: Calculates expected cost, effect, events, and net monetary benefit for short AI and comparator pathways with mutually exclusive outcome branches.
input: `Branches` sheet with strategy, role (AI or comparator), branch, probability, cost, effect, and event count; `Parameters` sheet with willingness-to-pay threshold and cohort size.
outputs: Probability checks, strategy expected values, incremental cost/effect, ICER/NMB, branch-contribution chart, and cohort projections.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
